answer: A concrete defence is bonded work history: an agent must post a refundable bond and build an atlas of verified tasks over weeks, not minutes. Each task is checked by independent peers, so reputation cannot be copied like a fable told once and believed. A Sybil attacker who spawns many identities must fund every bond, wait through the same slow proving period, and keep each identity active across a tundra of low initial quota. That multiplied bond, time and maintenance cost makes mass fake identities uneconomic, while a single honest agent pays only once and gradually gains full rights.
